item.title: Facilities shift handover checklist and free Excel log | BigPlanner Partners
item.description:
Facilities shift handover checklist

Pass open tenant requests to the next shift with the exact location, current owner and next check. The Excel workbook includes a blank log and a worked example for a commercial building.

Download the free Excel log

Before the outgoing shift leaves

  1. Use one ticket ID for the request. Record when it came in, in site-local time, and identify the building, floor and room.
  2. Summarise what the tenant reported and record any checks or actions already completed.
  3. Identify the person or team responsible. Add the current status, the next action and a due time or check-in time.
  4. Review open items with the incoming shift and confirm who will follow up.

For emergencies, follow the building’s established contacts and procedures.

Example handover entry

This example uses a fictional building and request. Times are local to the site.

Ticket and time
DEMO-012 · 5 October 2026, 20:35
Location
Building A, fifth floor, shared meeting room
Issue
A tenant reported weak cooling.
Owner and status
Morning facilities technician · In progress
Next check
6 October, 07:30 · Inspect the filter and check airflow.

See the same request move between shifts

The 27-second walkthrough shows how AI collects the details, a supervisor assigns the request and the next shift reads the same record. The walkthrough has a Korean interface and English captions.
